title: Conservation of non-consensus nucleotides in transcription factor binding sites
authors: Jenya Belousova; Roberto Morán-Tovar; Malancha Karmakar; Mikhail S. Gelfand
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转录因子结合位点中非共有核苷酸的保守性及其上位效应，涉及TF-DNA结合偏好与进化选择，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义TF-DNA互作的功能分析。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) affect gene expression by binding to their sites (TFBSs) in the genome. As regulation of transcription is essential for the optimization of metabolism, evolution of TFBSs is thought to be restricted by the TF binding preferences. This means that nucleotides important for binding (consensus nucleotides, CNs) experience the pressure of negative selection and, therefore, are highly conserved. However, for some regulated genes, the strongest possible repression or activation may not necessarily be optimal (i.e. provide the highest fitness). Here, we show that, along with CNs, nucleotides causing relatively weaker binding (non-consensus nucleotides, NCNs) are sometimes preserved by negative selection. We then consider several possible reasons for the conservation of NCNs and demonstrate that NCNs depend epistatically on other loci of the same TFBS for a substantial fraction of TFBSs.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过结合基因组中的结合位点（TFBSs）来影响基因表达。由于转录调控对代谢优化至关重要，TFBSs的进化被认为受到TF结合偏好的限制。这意味着对结合重要的核苷酸（共有核苷酸，CNs）承受负选择压力，因此高度保守。然而，对于某些受调控基因，最强的抑制或激活可能未必是最优的（即提供最高适应性）。在此，我们表明，与CNs一同，导致相对较弱结合的核苷酸（非共有核苷酸，NCNs）有时也通过负选择得以保留。随后，我们考虑了NCNs保守性的几种可能原因，并证明在相当一部分TFBSs中，NCNs依赖于同一TFBS的其他位点，表现出上位效应。
